# REPLAY-1: New replay data extends the message it travels with

- Append new data to the end of the existing DAL message, not a new one. The structs are not packed, so explicit `unused` bytes fill any alignment gap and keep the layout matching the format string. Zero must give the old behaviour, since Replay zero-fills what an older log lacks. A new message is for data written on its own schedule ([REPLAY-4](REPLAY-4.md)).

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the AP_NavEKF3 playbook, under [Data Abstraction Layer (DAL) and EKF Replay](../claude/libraries/AP_NavEKF3/CLAUDE.md#data-abstraction-layer-dal-and-ekf-replay). [All rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
